description: Read a file from a repo at a given ref. Mirrors GET /api/v2/repos/:owner/:repo/contents/:path. Returns {path, size, content, encoding, totalLines}. Pass `start_line` / `end_line` (1-based, inclusive) to read only part of a text file. A text file over ~60 KB read with no range returns its first ~60 KB of whole lines with `truncated: true`, `startLine`/`endLine` and a hint — ask for the next range to read on.

end_line.description: Last line to return (1-based, inclusive; clamped to the file's length). Text files only.

start_line.description: First line to return (1-based, inclusive). Text files only.

name: gluecron_read_file
